flaws.description: Swapped the axis label strings for GDP_Per_Capita and Average_Enrolment in the labels mapping so the x-axis now reads 'Average Enrolment Rate (%)' and the y-axis reads 'GDP Per Capita (USD)', mismatching the actual plotted quantities.

Swapped the 'Benin' and 'Senegal' country-name strings in the data dict's 'Country' list, so the two data points keep their original GDP/enrolment/literacy values and plotted positions/colors but are now mislabeled with each other's name in the legend and hover text.
